premises.text: Small businesses need branding but often cannot afford high-quality services
premises.evidence_span: Over 80 million small businesses out there want branding, need branding, but can't really afford it

premises.text: Taylor is a learning system that can design brands based on user input
premises.evidence_span: Taylor is a learning system that turns your computer into a graphic designer

premises.text: The design process is transparent and requires no payment until the user is satisfied
premises.evidence_span: the whole process is completely transparent, and no money exchanges hands until you're completely thrilled with your new design

premises.text: Taylor generates a large number of unique design options for each user input
premises.evidence_span: for every one user input we currently estimate, Taylor can generate 350,000 different design options

premises.text: Taylor provides ongoing design services for various business needs
premises.evidence_span: it's going to walk with your company and design everything it can possibly need

premises.text: The market for small business branding is significant, valued at $10 billion
premises.evidence_span: the 80 million small businesses account for a $10 billion industry

value.text: Small businesses can access high-quality branding services affordably
value.evidence_span: we want to make that accessible

notes: No traction metrics or promotional details coded.
